dedupe_keys.name: district heating network cost mapping and clustering for the entire french territory

description: This data set maps the cost of district heating network infrastructure across the whole of France and provides the algorithms used to produce it. It was published on Mendeley Data by Lukas Hofmann alongside the article by Hofmann and co-authors on how much district heating a future sector-coupled energy system needs, whose method maps and clusters network costs over an entire territory. Files are a user guide presenting the algorithms and data, network costs for the French territory at 400 by 400 metre resolution as a CSV and a GIS archive with empty pixels removed, and the algorithms as Python 3.12 Jupyter notebooks. Inputs listed for the French case are excess heat and heat demand from the EnRezo project (open), building floor areas from the CSTB national building database (not open) and ERA5 winter temperatures. Coverage is France at 400 metre resolution. The data are under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the method depends on a building data set that is not openly available, so rerunning it elsewhere needs a substitute. Simulation uses are district heating expansion planning and feeding clustered network costs into energy system optimisation models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
